experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM1895369: HS 2 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
study_title: The bromodomain protein BRD4 regulates splicing during heat shock
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM1895369: HS 2 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was purified using the RNA MicroPrep Kit (Zymo Research). Complementary DNA (cDNA) was generated using SuperScript II Reverse Transcriptase (Invitrogen) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. mRNA was reverse transcribed with random hexamers. Library preparations were performed with the TrueSeq RNA Sample Preparation Kit (Illumina) and sequencing was performed on the Illumina HighSeq 2500 with 50bp paired end sequencings.
